title: Pin-aware eval fanout and prioritization for catalog + tenant model upgrades
creator: Sofia Nakamura
description: Design and implement a pin-aware evaluation orchestration that triggers targeted eval runs when a model version is pinned or upgraded in either the canonical catalog or tenant-specific pins. Goal is to surface regressions quickly, prioritize high-impact tenants, and reduce cost by fan-out sampling and prioritized queues.
acceptance_criteria: Pin and catalog upgrades trigger evaluation job with tenant and catalog scoping metadata
Evaluations are classified into priority buckets (critical tenants, high-traffic routes, low-priority sampling) and scheduled accordingly
Synthetic smoke runs complete within 6 minutes for critical buckets and post results to the Quality dashboard
Automatic rollback signal emitted when predefined regression thresholds are exceeded
Audit log entry is created for each triggered eval with links to artifacts and owner
Cost budget for eval fanout is respected via sampling rules and quota checks
implementation_notes: Evaluation orchestration will call existing eval runner service (ENG-2411) with new 'pin_event' payload and priority flag
Introduce sampling policy DSL in Catalog service to define tenant/route priority and sampling rates
Fallback: if eval runners unavailable, enqueue a deferred job and send alert to oncall
We will surface per-tenant impact scoring in Console and attach to rollout screens
out_of_scope: Full end-to-end auto-rollback for Dedicated customers (radical changes require separate approvals)
Per-model fine-grain ML metric tuning — this ticket focuses on orchestration and signals only
